newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys two Dubai, three VLCC of Qua Iboe.
newsitem.headline: India buys two Dubai, three VLCC of Qua Iboe.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded two Dubai cargoes and three very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe in its January crude buying tender, traders said on Friday.
The Dubai cargoes were awarded to U.S. oil major Mobil Corp and U.S. trader Phibro, traders said.
Mobil was also awarded a VLCC of Qua Iboe on a Bonny Light/Qua Iboe (BQ) pricing basis.
The other two VLCCs of Qua Iboe were awarded to Swiss trader Glencore -- also on a BQ related price, the sources said.
However, traders said the Dubai cargoes had been offered at first half month quotes plus 65 to 68 cents per barrel on a free-on-board basis.
And the Qua Iboe VLCCs were offered between BQ plus 50 cents and BQ plus 56.5 cents per barrel on a cost and freight basis, traders said.
In its December purchases, India awarded four Dubai cargoes between first half month quotes plus 57 to 59 cents per barrel.
It also awarded three VLCCs of Qua Iboe in its December tender between dated Brent plus $1.1694 and $1.2795 per barrel.
